queries: WITH per_status AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation sc LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing')) SELECT insurstat, site_count, CAST(site_count AS REAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_status

responses.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation sc LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing')) SELECT insurstat, site_count, CAST(site_count AS REAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: A missing insurance status (NULL insurstat, or no matching site row) is grouped under the label 'Missing'. The foreign key means every zoneref should match a site, so the unmatched case is unlikely to occur.

The share is the status's distinct-site count divided by the sum of the per-status counts. Each site has one status, so this sum equals the total number of distinct sites with conservation records. The share is a plain division with no rounding.

responses.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation sc LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT insurstat, site_count, CAST(site_count AS REAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: Conservation records are matched to sites via scanconservation.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry. A LEFT JOIN keeps unmatched records, which fall into the NULL group. The foreign key makes unmatched records unlikely.
A missing status means a NULL insurstat. It is shown as its own group with a NULL status value, not relabeled. Empty strings are not treated as missing.
Each site has exactly one insurance status, so the per-status distinct counts are disjoint. The share denominator is therefore the total number of distinct sites with conservation records.

responses.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT insurstat, site_count, CAST(site_count AS REAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: Conservation records are matched to sites with an inner join on zoneref = zoneregistry. The foreign key means every record has a site, so none are dropped.
A NULL insurstat forms its own group. GROUP BY puts NULLs together, so the status column shows NULL for that group.
Each site has exactly one insurance status. So the per-status distinct counts add up to the total number of distinct sites, and the share is each count divided by that sum. The share is not rounded.
